title: fix(plugin-security): an OAuth MCP client's list_objects resolves its delegator once per request
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoSLDKWQ8v7cxY9uDGijfncD)_

Fixes #33179

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：用 OAuth 登录的 MCP 客户端代表某个人操作时，`list_objects` 现在每个请求只查一次「被代表的人」的权限，不再每个对象查两次。150 个对象的列表从 4620 条 SQL 降到 11 条，`describe_object` 从 22 条降到 11 条。
- 为什么改：每个对象都要重新读一遍这个人的用户行、成员、授权和岗位，对象一多、数据库在远端时，环境 owner 列一次对象要几十秒，接近客户端 60 秒超时。
- 风险与回滚：每个调用者看到的对象、字段数和顺序与 main 逐字节一致（有 golden 钉）；复用只在同一个请求上下文内，且任何写入都会立即作废，撤销授权或移除成员在同一请求内也立刻生效。回滚 = revert 本 PR，不涉及数据。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts` 新增的 `resolveDelegatorForContext`（约 L3776–L3845），以及 object-admission / field-readers 两处调用点的改动。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/mcp-list-objects-statements.pin.test.ts`，预期 19/19 通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The cost that grew.** An OAuth MCP client acts on behalf of a person (ADR-0090 D10: `onBehalfOf`, permissions `mcp_agent_data_read`). For such a caller, `list_objects` asks the security service two questions per object, `canReadObject` and `getMetadataReadableFields` (through `resolveObjectSchemaMaskPosture`). Each one called `resolveDelegatorContext(ql, context)`, which re-reads the person's `sys_user` row, memberships, permission-set grants, positions and activation rows (11 statements), and returns a fresh delegator context, so the per-context permission-set memo missed every time. That is 22 statements per listed object. Signed-in sessions and API keys carry no `onBehalfOf` and were already constant; this matches the card's split (OAuth slow, API key fast).
- **The fix.** `SecurityPlugin.resolveDelegatorForContext(context)` (private) memoizes `resolveDelegatorContext` per live context object, on the same discipline as `permissionSetMemo`: a `WeakMap` keyed on the context, reused only while the write epoch (`this.epoch.current`) and a key of `onBehalfOf.userId`, `tenantId` and `org_user_ids` stand. All three resolution kinds (`none`, `missing`, `resolved`) are memoized. A rejected resolution is dropped, not kept. Because the same resolved delegator context comes back, the delegator's own permission-set memo hits too.
- **Wired at the two object-schema read sites only:** `canReadObject` (`security-plugin-object-admission.ts`) and `computeReadableFields` (`security-plugin-field-readers.ts`). Both only read `del.context`, and both still run `delegatedOrganizationRefusal` themselves on every call. The other call sites (read filter, write admission, export, explain, operation principals, scope) are untouched, because some of them carry the delegator context onward.
- **Frozen.** The memoized resolution, its `context` and every array on it are frozen, so neither site (nor a future one) can mutate a shared answer.
- **No cache outlives the request.** The memo lives on the context object, which every door that produces an `onBehalfOf` context builds fresh per request (checked below). `mcp.ts` is unchanged: the security API is per object, so a bridge-side memo could not remove these reads.

## Tests

- **New `packages/runtime/src/mcp-list-objects-statements.pin.test.ts`**, a full kernel (`ObjectQLPlugin`, sqlite-wasm datasource, `PlatformObjectsPlugin`, `AuthPlugin`, `SecurityPlugin`, `SharingServicePlugin`, REST, dispatcher) with the dev admin as owner and a member signed up by invitation. The OAuth callers are built by `assembleExecutionContext` with an `oauth` grant, the way `/mcp` builds them. Statements are counted with knex's `query` event inside an `AsyncLocalStorage`.
  - ⭐ round-trip pin, for owner, member, ownerAgent and memberAgent: statements per `list_objects` at 150 objects equal those at 10, within 2.
  - ⭐ the delegated callers pay their delegator once: a listing costs at most one `describe_object` on main (22).
  - answer-identity golden: the sha256 of each caller's listing at 10 and 150 objects and of `describe_object`, taken from the main-side run, must match byte for byte.
  - CONTROL: `describe_object` answers unchanged for all four callers.
  - ⭐ invalidation pin: inside one bridge (one context), the memberAgent lists, the member's `sys_member` rows are deleted, and the next listing is strictly narrower and a subset (rows restored in `finally`).
- **Why a new file.** `mcp-object-schema-mask.test.ts`'s rig has no identity tables, so no delegator can be resolved there.
- **Census pin updated** in `delegated-organization-membership.test.ts`. It counts the files that resolve a delegator and must also refuse a foreign organization. It now counts `this.resolveDelegatorForContext(context` as a resolution, and checks that the memo resolves in exactly one place. The seven-file list is unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- **Time-limited grants.** A request now judges the delegator's time-limited grants at one instant, its first resolution, instead of at each object. This makes one listing coherent and changes no answer outside a sub-second boundary (only a grant whose window closes inside that request).
- **Ruling #11971** (`buildContextForUser`: "⭐ Ruled bypass of the #11633 leg-B grants cache", maintainer acceptance 2026-08-25). That ruling keeps the explainer off the cross-request grants cache. It still holds. The new memo is per context, epoch-invalidated, and not a grants cache. `buildContextForUser` keeps `bypassGrantsCache: true`, and the explain call sites are untouched.
- **Doors that produce `onBehalfOf` (seat condition 1).**
  - The runtime `/mcp` door builds it per request (`resolveExecutionContext` → `assembleExecutionContext` with `oauth`).
  - REST forward-agent builds it per `req` (`execCtxMemo`).
  - stdio, print, settings, storage, messaging and the other `assembleExecutionContext` callers pass `oauth: undefined`, so they produce no delegated context.
  - The tool-call interceptor's `toolCallPrincipalOf` is a frozen projection, not a context the security service is asked with. The explain engine's `onBehalfOf` (explain-engine.ts) is output only.
  - No door keeps one delegated context across requests.
- **Hosted was not reachable.** Every figure below is from a local in-memory sqlite kernel. The hosted estimate is an inference only: about 22 round trips per object × about 170 objects on a remote database gives tens of seconds, which matches the 44 s report.
- **Serial.** Open PRs #33194 and #33188 touch `runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`, which this PR does not edit. No open PR touches the three plugin-security files.
- **Ruling grep** (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔`) on the touched surface: security-plugin.ts 80 hits (only "ruling 6278784335 letter B" touches delegation, outside the edited region); object-admission 3; field-readers 1. None governs this memo besides #11971 above.

## Verification

All readings are at head `04753f4b` (base `68972cd2`; `origin/main` merged once at `f8b2d950`, with no overlap with the touched files), unless named otherwise.

<details><summary>Measured at origin/main first, then after (statements per call, real kernel, in-memory sqlite)</summary>

| caller | objects listed (10 / 150 app objects) | main statements 10 → 150 | main wall 10 → 150 | after statements 10 → 150 | after wall 10 → 150 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| owner (signed in) | 68 / 208 | 0 → 0 | — | 0 → 0 | — |
| member (signed in) | 29 / 29 | 0 → 0 | — | 0 → 0 | — |
| ownerAgent (OAuth, on behalf of owner) | 49 / 189 | 1540 → 4620 | 1057 ms → 2059 ms | 11 → 11 | 31 ms → 40 ms |
| memberAgent (OAuth, on behalf of member) | 23 / 23 | 1260 → 3780 | 642 ms → 1734 ms | 9 → 9 | 28 ms → 44 ms |

`describe_object`: ownerAgent 22 → 11, memberAgent 18 → 9 statements. The listings and descriptions hash identically before and after:

| caller | 10 objects | 150 objects |
|---|---|---|
| owner | `304fb285…` | `9edb5243…` |
| member | `1c5b772f…` | `1c5b772f…` |
| ownerAgent | `f4e77a4d…` | `d0342442…` |
| memberAgent | `6e73539a…` | `6e73539a…` |

Growth on main is 22 statements per extra listed object for ownerAgent ((4620 − 1540) / 140), which is 2 security calls × 11 statements.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each leg rebuilt through dist, then restored)</summary>

- **A, memo hook-up removed** (`resolveDelegatorForContext` returns `resolveDelegatorContext(this.ql, context)` directly): 3 failed | 16 passed.
  - ownerAgent: `expected 3080 to be less than or equal to 2`
  - memberAgent: `expected 2520 to be less than or equal to 2`
  - delegated-once pin: `ownerAgent: expected 4620 to be less than or equal to 22`
  - The golden hashes still matched, so main's answers are the ones this PR keeps.
- **B, epoch check removed** (a hit no longer compares `this.epoch.current`): 1 failed | 18 passed.
  - invalidation pin: `expected 23 to be less than 23`, so the delegator's removed membership was not seen inside the request.
- **Restored:** 19 passed (19). `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` exited 0 and the tree was clean.

</details>

<details><summary>Suites, gates, lint</summary>

- `mcp-list-objects-statements.pin.test.ts` at head: Tests 19 passed (19).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test`: Test Files 267 passed (267), Tests 6605 passed | 45 skipped (6650), exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: Test Files 598 passed (598), Tests 10620 passed | 19 skipped (10639), exit 0.
- runtime MCP suites (`mcp-object-schema-mask`, the bridge tests): 5 files, 251 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 70 families derived. All 70 were run with `</dev/null` and every exit code was recorded. `--ran` reconciliation: "70 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 70 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED".
  - `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first answered 3 on a shallow clone. It answered 0 after fetching the commit it reads.
  - `check:i18n` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered 3 (not built). They answered 0 after a full build.
  - `check:test-source-alias` first answered 1 on a lazy `@objectstack/metadata` load in the new pin. The load moved to the module top, and the gate now answers 0.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.

</details>
